canonical_authority.canonical_field: effective_status (with configured_status as the seed file's own declared value before any fail-closed/downgrade-only override is applied)

downstream_derivation.run_artifact: comqutor_alpha/exposure_engine.py writes entity_alpha_exposures.json per run with top-level configured_status/effective_status/mode, and the same fields repeated per Alpha record.
downstream_derivation.run_audit: comqutor_alpha/api/routes_research.py's entity_exposure block carries mode/current_seed_status/seed_approval_status/enforcement_allowed, cross-checked by the seed_status_consistency accounting invariant (formula: entity_exposure_audit.current_seed_status == _current_seed_status(ticker)).
downstream_derivation.live_api_current_seed_status: comqutor_alpha.api.routes_research._current_seed_status(ticker) resolves FRESH from the live seed file on every call (never cached, never derived from a frozen artifact) and is exposed on GET /api/research/{run_id}/entity-exposures as current_seed_status -- deliberately kept separate from the run's OWN frozen configured_status/effective_status so a historical run's frozen state and today's live state are never conflated.
downstream_derivation.frontend: frontend/src/api/types.ts declares EntityExposureLifecycleStatus = 'draft_shadow'|'approved_gating'|'disabled' as canonical; configured_status/effective_status are the current fields; mode ('off'|'shadow'|'enforced') and seed_approval_status are explicitly @deprecated legacy aliases, kept only for backward compatibility with historical payloads. frontend/src/components/AlphaCard.tsx's resolveLifecycleStatus() prefers effective_status and only falls back to translating the legacy mode field for payloads that predate effective_status entirely.
downstream_derivation.regression_report_v3: Contains no Entity Exposure / seed-status field at all -- out of scope for that report, confirmed by direct grep (no false-authority risk there).

canonical_status_confirmed_not_assumed: Verified by reading comqutor_alpha/exposure/seed_loader.py's own module docstring and constants (DRAFT_SHADOW/APPROVED_GATING/DISABLED, CANONICAL_STATUSES), not merely because a prior closure report asserted it.

legacy_vocabulary_mapping.note: This is a deterministic, code-enforced mapping (comqutor_alpha/exposure/seed_loader.py), not two independently-maintained sources of truth that could drift apart.

historical_shadow_draft_wording_investig.classification: MULTIPLE_LEGITIMATE_EXPLANATIONS -- A, B, and C all apply; D (still genuinely contradictory) does NOT apply to the current final six-run set

explanation_A_old_deprecated_status_temp.detail: comqutor_alpha/api/routes_research.py::_current_seed_status()'s own docstring documents the historical root cause verbatim: 'John observed inconsistent approved_gating/shadow/draft wording -- root cause was old per-run artifacts persisted before a ticker's approval date, served verbatim forever after.' A run executed BEFORE a ticker's seed was approved would freeze draft_shadow/shadow in its own entity_alpha_exposures.json forever, while the LIVE seed file had since moved to approved_gating -- an old screenshot and a new screenshot of the SAME ticker would legitimately show different wording because they capture different points in time, not because of a bug in either single artifact.
explanation_A_old_deprecated_status_temp.status: FIXED (this session, Section B) -- current_seed_status is now resolved fresh from the live seed file on every API call and exposed as an explicitly separate field from the run's own frozen configured_status/effective_status, so the two are never conflated again.

explanation_B_different_subsystem_visual.detail: Alpha Memory (comqutor_alpha/memory/*, added this session) exposes its own, completely unrelated field: alpha_memory.mode = 'shadow'. This describes whether the Alpha Memory feedback-loop feature is audit-only (it always is, currently) -- it has nothing to do with Entity Exposure gating. A screenshot showing 'Alpha Memory SHADOW' next to a screenshot showing 'Entity Exposure: approved_gating' can look like the same subsystem disagreeing with itself, but they are two different top-level API fields (alpha_memory.mode vs entity_exposure.effective_status / current_seed_status) belonging to two different subsystems.
explanation_B_different_subsystem_visual.explicit_statement_for_johns_screenshots: Alpha Memory mode = shadow is NOT the same field as Entity Exposure seed/gating status = approved_gating. Never present a screenshot mixing the two without labeling which field/subsystem it is.

explanation_C_stale_ui_or_field_naming.detail: frontend/src/api/types.ts explicitly marks two fields @deprecated: mode ('off'|'shadow'|'enforced', the pre-existing internal vocabulary) and seed_approval_status (a backward-compatible alias of configured_status). Both are still PRESENT on the wire for backward compatibility, and both are DETERMINISTICALLY DERIVED from the same canonical effective_status (LEGACY_MODE_BY_STATUS mapping) -- so a screenshot showing the deprecated field name is showing old NAMING, not a different or conflicting VALUE. AlphaCard.tsx's resolveLifecycleStatus() already prefers effective_status and only reads the legacy mode field as a fallback for historical payloads that predate effective_status entirely.
explanation_C_stale_ui_or_field_naming.additional_note: The canonical status value itself is literally named draft_shadow, whose UI label is 'Draft shadow' -- so a ticker that is genuinely not yet approved is SUPPOSED to display the word 'shadow' as part of its correct, current, canonical status label. That is a real, valid state value, not a bug, and is a third source of the word 'shadow' appearing on screen that must not be confused with either A or B above.

explanation_D_still_genuinely_contradict.detail: Verified directly: all six FINAL_FRESH_SELECTED runs show configured_status == effective_status == 'approved_gating', uniformly across every per-Alpha record within each run, with the deprecated mode field correctly mapping to 'enforced' in every case, the run_audit seed_status_consistency invariant passing on all six, and the LIVE (freshly-resolved) current_seed_status matching the frozen artifact value exactly on all six via direct GET /api/research/{run_id}/entity-exposures. Zero contradictions found in the current final six-run set.

verification_method: 1. Read comqutor_alpha/exposure/seed_loader.py source directly for the canonical status constants and vocabulary -- not assumed from a prior report.

2. Read outputs/runs/<run_id>/entity_alpha_exposures.json for all six runs: checked top-level configured_status/effective_status/mode AND per-Alpha-record uniformity (all records within a run must agree).
3. Read outputs/runs/<run_id>/run_audit.json's entity_exposure block and its seed_status_consistency accounting invariant for all six runs.

4. Issued a live, read-only GET /api/research/{run_id}/entity-exposures against all six already-completed runs (no new research triggered) and compared the freshly-resolved current_seed_status to the frozen artifact value.
5. Read frontend/src/api/types.ts and frontend/src/components/AlphaCard.tsx to confirm the deprecated/legacy fields are correctly, deterministically derived and never independently authoritative.
6. Grepped docs/audit_artifacts/regression_report_v3.json for any exposure/seed reference -- none found, confirmed out of scope there.
